title: OAuth code flow
goal: Show OAuth authorization-code sign-in with PKCE.

rubric.must: Consent and redirect with code visibly precede Client token request.
The redirect names PKCE challenge and token request names code and verifier.
Client and Auth have activation bars.
A note over Client and Auth says Back-channel code exchange.
